PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-019.text: Token validity requires both is_used=false AND expires_at >= now().
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-019.assertion: forall t: use_token(t) => t.is_used == false AND t.expires_at >= now()

locations.note: OAuth auth codes: code fetched at L70-80 (returns invalid_grant if not found/deleted), expiry checked at L101-106. Replay prevention via DELETE at L83 (no is_used flag; code is physically removed). Note: is_used field does not exist in stem-system's OAuth code model.
